inputs.locator: Decision feature: after each complete UTC day, calculate the latest close divided by the maximum close of the latest 365 complete UTC days including current, minus one. A drawdown at or below minus 20 percent is high risk; minus 15 and minus 25 percent are rejection-only neighbors. Execute a changed target only at the next H1 open.

Frozen policy and accounting: hold 100 percent unlevered BTC above the threshold and 50 percent BTC plus 50 percent zero-yield cash at or below it. Compare with full-capital buy-and-hold on the same H1 path, valuation and costs. Design is 2020-2022, Validation is 2023-2024 and annual fair-reset folds are 2020-2024. Normal costs are 10 bps fee plus 5 bps adverse slippage per side; stress costs are 20 plus 10 bps.

Frozen all-pass gates require positive normal and stress returns, at least 70 percent upside capture, Design drawdown at most 90 percent and Validation drawdown at most 85 percent of buy-and-hold, Calmar at least buy-and-hold, sufficient state support, stable rejection-only neighbors, annual breadth, concentration, holding and terminal-inventory quality. Any failure closes the family without tuning.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen BTC daily trailing-365-complete-day drawdown passive-core overlay on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the primary minus-20-percent high-risk state with rejection-only minus-15 and minus-25-percent neighbors against full-capital buy-and-hold under identical normal and stress costs. Freeze a historical candidate only if every Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, holding, terminal and neighbor gate passes; otherwise permanently close the exact family without tuning. This is historical development evidence, not OOS or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: A current close at least 20 percent below the highest close in the latest 365 complete UTC days may mark a persistent cumulative-loss state in which retaining only a permanent half-size BTC core reduces subsequent path loss. Recovery above the same threshold restores full exposure without a fitted forecast.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one pre-2025 historical Design and Validation decision for trailing-365-day drawdown thresholds of minus 15, 20 and 25 percent and a state-change-only 100/50-percent BTC passive-core policy. It cannot inspect post-2024 data, select a neighbor, tune any formula or gate, activate a strategy or open OOS unless every frozen gate passes.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The primary minus-20-percent state should materially reduce maximum drawdown versus full-capital buy-and-hold while preserving at least 70 percent of upside and improving after-cost Calmar, with annual, threshold-neighbor, holding and terminal-inventory breadth.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The overlay may merely reduce exposure after losses, miss rebounds and create a visually smaller but economically inferior path. One frozen matched-capital screen either admits the exact family to independent sealed OOS or closes it before more lookbacks, thresholds and weights consume capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The trailing-365-day minus-20-percent cumulative-loss state improves after-cost risk-adjusted performance versus full-capital buy-and-hold in both Design and historical Validation, with stable minus-15 and minus-25-percent rejection-only neighbors and broad annual support.

decision_time.availability_rule: The latest complete UTC day's close and all 365 closes in the trailing-peak window are known at that day's close. The 100 or 50 percent target is executed only if the state changes, at the H1 open with the same timestamp as that completed daily close; no later price enters the decision.

stop_conditions: Before outcome access, validate exact task, dispatch, intent and strategy path; rehash all non-null inputs and require clean HEAD equal to origin after the package commit. Any failure is BTC_DAILY_TRAILING365D_DRAWDOWN20_PASSIVE_CORE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT.
Require the sealed H1 corpus SHA-256 e436a5a2b093365886464dd3e471cc5cd55c54bd2c06ceaa898ac218c45436dd with 52608 contiguous finite rows and 2192 complete UTC days. Do not repair a failure.

Use only the latest close drawdown from the maximum close of the latest 365 complete UTC days, minus-20-percent primary and minus-15/minus-25-percent rejection-only neighbors, at-or-below high-risk equality, next-H1-open state-change-only 100/50 exposure and frozen costs, windows and gates.
Run the frozen runner twice to new create-only outputs and require byte-identical SHA-256 results.
Return the positive disposition only if every frozen gate passes; otherwise valid economics returns BTC_DAILY_TRAILING365D_DRAWDOWN20_PASSIVE_CORE_RISK_OVERLAY_FAMILY_CLOSE without tuning.
A positive result remains historical and REPORTED_NOT_ACTIVATED. It authorizes at most one independent sealed OOS and no Trading action.
